purpose: Bounded continuous close-only sentinel run against the authenticated practice broker (CLI OAuth). Isolated validation ledger only; NOT strategy performance. Comparison ledger untouched.
account: authorized ordinary U.S. practice account (SIMULATE, market 100, type 1); ID redacted; competition account never addressed
healthy_false_reason: Strategy runtime is SHADOW; risk.entries_allowed is False, so the sentinel correctly reports risk_state_blocks_entries. A flat, released strategy would report healthy.
latency_finding: Each tick performs multiple authenticated CLI subprocess calls (account_list, cash_info, position_list, quote, final reconciliation), measuring ~4.2 s/tick (0.24 Hz). This is honest measured loop latency, NOT a sub-second stop guarantee. CLI polling is too slow for tight 0.10xATR stop protection; a faster streaming transport (e.g. OpenD push) would be required for sub-second stops. Triggered-stop quote-to-order latency still requires a demonstrated stop event.
